cohort: A sample of 207 pregnant women undergoing cesarean sections with spinal anesthesia at the National Maternal Perinatal Institute of Lima.
finding: The incidence of severe hypotension after spinal anesthesia in cesarean sections was 26.6%, and maternal age >= 35 years, baseline systolic pressure >110 mmHg, newborn weight < 4,000 g, and anesthesiologist experience < 5 years were identified as significant risk factors.
birth_weight: Not specified as an inclusion criterion; newborn weight < 4,000 g was a studied risk factor.
